annotations.title: Save the person's CV (text or a file)

description: Save the person's CV (text or a file). Saves the CV encrypted and reads titles, skills, years and education from it. Send the text as cv, or a file as file_base64 with filename. Can also set name, phone and links at the same time. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.

file_base64.description: A CV file (.docx, .pdf, .txt or .md), base64-encoded, instead of cv.

filename.description: The file name, for example cv.docx.

intros.description: Open to employers asking for an introduction (anonymous until the person says yes each time).

location.description: Where the person lives, for example Leeds.

offers.description: Quietly tell the person about the right offer.

name: upload_cv
title: Save the person's CV (text or a file)
